is_stale.label: Is stale
is_stale.help_text: Whether this stream is stale (not seen in recent refresh, pending deletion)

is_adult.label: Is adult
is_adult.help_text: Whether this stream contains adult content

is_custom.label: Is custom
is_custom.help_text: Whether this is a user-created stream or from an M3U account

stream_hash.label: Stream hash
stream_hash.help_text: Unique hash for this stream from the M3U account

stream_stats.label: Stream stats
stream_stats.help_text: JSON object containing stream statistics like video codec, resolution, etc.

stream_stats_updated_at.label: Stream stats updated at
stream_stats_updated_at.help_text: When stream statistics were last updated

stream_id.label: Stream id
stream_id.help_text: Provider stream ID (e.g., XC stream_id) for stable identity across credential changes

stream_chno.label: Stream chno
stream_chno.help_text: Provider channel number (XC num or M3U tvg-chno) for ordering - supports decimals like 2.1

catchup_days.label: Catchup days
catchup_days.help_text: Number of days of catch-up archive available (tv_archive_duration)

is_radio.label: Is radio
is_radio.help_text: Whether this stream is a radio (audio-only) stream, per the provider
